title: Parse simple CSV into objects
prompt: Create `csv.js` (CommonJS) exporting `parseCsv(text)`. The first line is a header row of comma-separated column names. Each subsequent non-empty line is a record; return an array of objects mapping header -> cell value (all values are strings). Trim surrounding whitespace on each cell. Ignore a trailing blank line. You do NOT need to handle quoted fields or embedded commas. The test file `verify.test.js` is present and must pass via `node --test verify.test.js`. Do NOT modify the test file.
